new_result: For arbitrary sizes m,n and zero-diagonal weighted partial-permutation matrices A,B (at most one nonzero per row and column), independently up to local unitary similarity, ||A⊗I_n+I_m⊗B||op²≤m_A+m_B≤||A||F²+||B||F², where m_A=max_p(|a_p|²+|a_{σ^{-1}p}|²) for any completing permutation (fixed points have weight0), and similarly m_B. Proof is pointwise two-term Cauchy–Schwarz at each output: every input coefficient receives two distinct local weights per side, or repeated fixed-point weights that vanish. Thus d4 T2-dual holds with explicit gap≥2[(||A||²−m_A)+(||B||²−m_B)]. This strictly extends common-cycle weighted shifts to unequal cycles and paths, including both-square-nonnormal pairs near rank1. The cyclic subclass retains a complete equality classification: equality iff each factor has ≤1 nonzero weight, via grade-block cyclic-bidiagonal support graphs with no 4-cycles.
